# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free US freelancer and 1099 tax calculator for 2026: enter revenue and expenses to see self-employment tax, federal income tax with the QBI deduction, a state estimate, quarterly payments and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## What it handles

- The 1040-ES safe harbor: 90% of this year's federal tax, or 100% of last year's (110% when last year's AGI was over $150,000; enter it, or this year's stands in). With $0 tax last year it reports no underpayment penalty.
- With W-2 wages, the set-aside is only the tax the freelance profit adds.
